name: open floor
description: An open floor or bare ground. Can be walked across by anything, and can hold traps or items. Does not break line of sight.

name: closed door
description: Doors may be locked; getting through them may not be easy. Your disarming skill makes all the difference to your ability to handle locks, but you can also take a pickaxe to them, or blast them open with magic. Monsters are also slowed down by doors; you can earn yourself valuable time by locking them.

name: open door
description: A door that is already open. Player, monster, spell and missile can pass through as long as it stays open.

name: broken door
description: A door so broken that it cannot be shut.

name: up staircase
description: A staircase up to a shallower part of the dungeon.

name: down staircase
description: A staircase down to a deeper part of the dungeon.

name: General Store
description: The General Store sells food, ammunition and lighting supplies.

name: Armoury
description: The armour sold here will give you some protection against the blows of your enemies.

name: Weapon Smiths
description: Weapons for hitting and shooting your enemies are forged in the hot, acrid backroom of this enticing shop.

name: Bookseller
description: A quiet, reflective place of refuge, lined with shelves of mystical tomes.

name: Alchemy shop
description: A dim, scented room where potions and scrolls are traded.

name: Magic shop
description: A shop for devices and adornments with magic trapped within.

name: Black market
description: Watch your back and hold onto your purse as you enter this disreputable haunt - and do not expect friendly service or good bargains.

name: Home
description: Your safe piece of Middle Earth, and the only place you can store goods apart from on your person.

name: secret door
description: A door that appears like a granite wall to untrained eyes.

name: pile of rubble
description: Ends LOS, stops missiles, bolts, and beams. May dissolve or be tunnelled to normal floor.

name: pile of passable rubble
description: Ends LOS, stops missiles, bolts, and beams, and reduces the radius of ball spells. May dissolve or be tunnelled to normal floor, and can be walked through by the player and monsters.

name: magma vein
description: A seam of soft rock. It can be removed by digging or magic, and passed through by immaterial monsters. It stops any spells, missiles or line of sight.

name: quartz vein
description: A seam of hardish rock. It can be removed by digging or magic, and passed through by immaterial monsters. It stops any spells, missiles or line of sight.

name: magma vein with treasure
description: A seam of soft rock. It can be removed by digging or magic, and passed through by immaterial monsters. It stops any spells, missiles or line of sight. It contains visible treasure.

name: quartz vein with treasure
description: A seam of hardish rock. It can be removed by digging or magic, and passed through by immaterial monsters. It stops any spells, missiles or line of sight. It contains visible treasure.

name: granite wall
description: A seam of hard rock. It can be removed by digging or magic, and passed through by immaterial monsters. It stops any spells, missiles or line of sight.

name: permanent wall
description: You can dig through most walls but these are impenetrable. The dungeon is surrounded by these kinds of walls and some special rooms are made of them.

name: lava stream
description: A fiery pool of glowing lava. Step in it at your peril!
